answer: We resist Sybils via game-theoretic multi-agent auditing, stake slashing, and topological cut verifications. Auditing agents inspect clustered network cuts: if fake identities collude, their staked deposits are slashed, driving attacker costs to scale exponentially with cluster size. Under this protocol, an honest audit node codenamed sparrow tracks transaction graphs, an opal token deposit serves as bonded collateral, and reaching the trust zenith requires non-separable graph proofs.
